candidates.description: Automatically set up supermemory (Perfect agent memory) in your own agent or application, end-to-end. Asks user questions, chooses the right context solution for the agent and does the implementation for you.
candidates.source: research_notes/ShogunAgent AIエージェント向けサービス戦略/supermemory_deep_dive.md §B6 (skills/supermemory/README.md frontmatter description).

candidates.description: Mem0: the memory layer for AI apps. Add, search, get and delete memories scoped per user or agent; graph memory with entity linking; Dream consolidation of memories over time. OpenMemory MCP keeps memory on the user's machine for Cursor, Claude Desktop, Windsurf and Cline. Use it to give your assistant persistent memory of the user across sessions.
candidates.source: Paraphrased from research_notes/ShogunAgent AIエージェント向けサービス戦略/memory_competitor_landscape.md (Mem0 row and profile).

candidates.description: Zep: managed temporal knowledge-graph memory for agents, built on the Graphiti engine. Ingest episodes (messages, documents) into a per-user graph; retrieve a context block of relevant facts and entities for the current thread; graph search over entities and relationships with custom entity and edge types.
candidates.source: Paraphrased from research_notes/ShogunAgent AIエージェント向けサービス戦略/memory_competitor_landscape.md (Zep / Graphiti row).

candidates.description: Search the public web and read pages. Returns ranked links with snippets for a query, or the readable text of a single public URL as Markdown. Use for current facts, news, documentation and finding pages to read. Not for the user's own notes or documents.
